what_happened: context/project/lean4/patterns/dependency-tracing.md Shape 1 (forward transitive closure) uses bare ci.value?, which on Lean v4.33 returns none for every thmInfo unless allowOpaque := true is passed. The probe therefore walks TYPES ONLY for theorems and silently reports a clean closure. First run over all 68 marker sites returned zero field-access hits with plausible-looking closure sizes (12-974 constants), which the doc's own anti-silence heuristic ('a non-trivial closure size is evidence the traversal is doing real work') does NOT catch. Fix: ci.value? (allowOpaque := true).

A single compiled metaprogram (transitive constant-closure over the elaborated proof term, matched against the 8 constants through which FrameOver.IsRegular's four fields can be read) classified all 68 marker sites in one run, replacing the planned per-site transplant-probe sweep (68 scratch copies + 68 compiles). Validated against 6 hand-corrected control markers in UniversalCover.lean/HistoryMorphism.lean/TaskFrame.lean, all reproduced exactly; value-only and type+value variants agree on all 68 rows; 0 of 68 module-provenance mismatches. Probe retained at specs/evidence/constraints-consumed-marker-audit/marker-consumption-probe.lean.

Correcting an over-reporting marker on a binder-carrying declaration FAILS check-module-invariants.sh C34a (enforced, exit-code-affecting), because C34a refuses any marker omitting a constraint its own binder supplies unless discharged by delegation to a binder-free twin or by field re-export. Simulated against the live census for 4 representative sites (PathHom.toPath_comp, PathHom.id, mem_lawHist_iff_isStepPath, base_taskRel_eq_ofStepRel): all 4 FAIL. 22 of the 28 over-reporters carry the binder, so a docstring-only edit is not available for them; each needs a binder-free twin (or binder removal) landed in the same phase as the marker edit.

docs/development/MODULE_INVARIANTS.md (C34 row) and docs/development/REFERENCE_NORMAL_FORM.md both state the live C34a discharge-group counts as 7 omit-nothing / 18 delegation / 2 re-export. A live run of the C34 block reports 62 omit-nothing / 22 delegation / 2 re-export over 163 markers and 341 binder-carrying declarations. The two prose counts are stale by a wide margin.
